{{Quote|I need some information about Stonewall Labs. You worked there?|A spacer, to [[Zanier Hudmasse]]|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />}}
'''Stonewall Labs''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-engineering company based on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Labs have been closed down for almost a year and no one has seen Professor Cordelis in that time.|Zanier Hudmasse, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />}}
[[File:StonewallLabs.jpg|250px|thumb|The exterior of Stonewall Labs]]
The Stonewall Labs headquarters was located in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Naboo. Located east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], the laboratory was home to a wide number of different [[Droid/Legends|droid]] models, including [[ZH-28 guard]]s, [[SWL-5 overseer]]s, [[LC-92 antagonist]]s, and [[Mechthorian]]s. The laboratory was also filled with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], which fulfilled surveillance, watchman, and preserver roles, painted different [[Color/Legends|colors]] depending on their role.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

==History==
{{Quote|Professor Lancil Cordelis, the owner of the Stonewall Labs, closed the facility down some time ago.|Zanier Hudmasse, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />}}
[[File:StonewallLabs2.jpg|250px|thumb|The [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] in the interior of Stonewall Labs]]
Stonewall Labs was owned by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Lancil Cordelis]]. Staff included Professor [[Zanier Hudmasse]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> technician [[Tanoa Vills]],<ref name="SWG:GtTV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Go to Tanoa Vills|Naboo}}</ref> [[Chief of Security|Security Chief]] [[Vance Groten]],<ref name="SWG:HKDPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Help Keep Dee'Ja Peak Safe" on Naboo</ref> and [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] [[Kippy Martin]] and [[Walker Luskeske]].<ref name="SWG:FaSB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find a Security Beacon|Naboo}}</ref> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Professor Cordelis closed the laboratory and disappeared without a trace.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was trying to acquire an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module from Stonewall Labs met with Zanier Hudmasse, Vance Groten and Tanoa Vills. The three agreed to help the spacer in this mission, allowing the spacer to enter the Stonewall Labs headquarters and find an Old Republic [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] that was being studied there. The spacer destroyed the droideka in the laboratory, and finally recovered a Strategy/Tactics Simulation Chip installed in the droideka.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> The spacer also collected an [[ion relic pistol]] left behind in the lab.<ref name="SWG:RPWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Pistol Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Stonewall Labs was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Stonewall Labs was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
